title: USP Waitlist Extension
description: Waitlist extension schema for the Universal Scheduling Protocol. Enables buyers to join a queue when desired time slots are fully booked. Extends dev.usp-protocol.services.bookings.

WaitlistEntry.title: WaitlistEntry
WaitlistEntry.description: Tracks a buyer's position and preferences in the waitlist queue. When a spot opens (due to cancellation or reschedule), the business offers it to the next eligible waitlisted buyer.

service_id.description: The service the buyer is waitlisted for.

preferred_slots.description: Preferred time windows. If omitted, the buyer accepts any available slot.

status.description: Current waitlist status. waiting: in queue. offered: slot offered. accepted: converted to booking. expired/declined: offer not accepted. removed: buyer left waitlist.

position.description: Current position in the waitlist queue (1-based).

offered_slot.description: The slot being offered to this buyer. Present when status is offered.

offer_expires_at.description: RFC 3339 expiration time for the current offer. Present when status is offered.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the entry was created.

revision.description: OPTIONAL. Opaque concurrency token for the current state of this waitlist entry, used for conditional writes (specification.md Section 5.6). Same semantics as Booking.revision: a business that returns it MUST honour a matching precondition on leave/accept/decline - If-Match on REST, _meta.usp.if_match on MCP - and MUST reject a stale one. This matters most on accept: an offer that has already been accepted or has expired must not be accepted twice by two agents racing on the same entry. Its presence in a response IS the advertisement that conditional writes are supported. The value MUST change whenever the entry changes, MUST NOT be reused, and MUST be treated as opaque by platforms.

Buyer.title: Buyer
Buyer.description: The person making and paying for the booking. When no separate recipient is specified, the buyer is also the person receiving the service.
